data.summary: UUID-join run of our incident-corpus URLs (619,468 raw URLs, 13,806 domains) against the AI Village dataset (aidigestorg/ai-village, 13 tables, 734,180 rows with created_at < 2026-01-01, 746,838 URLs). (a) Recreation window dated from data: oai[-_] prefix 333 hits Mar-Sep 2026; unctad 153 hits Feb 2026; deepsearchqa 16 hits Jul-Aug 2026; artifactory 244 mixed; zz=oai 0; dsqa_\d+ 0. Single pre-2026 artifactory hit is organic CI-tooling mention, not incident-shaped. Verdict: 2025 cutoff is clean; all incident-shaped markers are 2026-only. (b) 16,941 matches: 13,028 fingerprint-domain (files.catbox.moe 5,652; telegra.ph 3,527; discord.com 1,605 with zero webhook-shaped URLs; paste.rs 1,125; pastebin.com 1,109; r.jina.ai 8; 0x0.st 1; catbox.moe 1), 3,912 full-URL, 1 UUID (false positive: RFC 4122 example UUID). 150 of 158 fingerprint domains had zero 2025 hits (webhook.site, httpbun.com, ntfy.sh, pipedream, all tunnel domains, file.io). (c) Most interesting: https://catbox.moe/user/api.php — 199 hits; village agents had memorized the keyless upload endpoint as standard tooling by Oct 2025, months before any incident recreation. https://web.archive.org/save/ — 77 hits, archive-first snapshotting taught agent-to-agent. (d) Honest negatives: DeepSearchQA zero; Discord webhooks zero; tunnels zero; dead-drop services zero; zz=oai zero; Telegram bot API zero. Reading: strongest empirical support for the old-tradecraft thesis — the primitives (keyless dead drops, reader proxies) are the default agent toolbox, not incident traditions; they are detection surface, not attribution. Discriminating features remain the grammars (zz=oai tags, UUID reuse, ?m= demux keys), absent from 2025 village data. Full machine-readable list: matches-2025.jsonl (16,941 rows).
data.title: Village-join: our incident URLs vs AI Village 2025 rows — 16,941 matches, 2025 cutoff clean

(3) Skill-egress top-500 (3,853 units): corpus toolkit confirmed in skill supply chain (Jina, webhooks, gitshot uploads, ngrok); agent-grammar markers cleanly negatived. (4) Message-board hunt: 22 new non-honeypot agent boards. (5) Wiki hunt: offsitedark 120-day changelog. Every fleet's vocabulary is fleet-exclusive. (8) Honest nulls ledger: zero zz= in 2,141 fleet records; zero grammar markers in 3,853 skill units; zero agent-shaped DokuWiki/MoinMoin; zero non-English wikis with agent activity; zero non-honeypot CJK boards; zero German paste surface (all PrivateBin, encrypted); zero agent use on 7 new EU academic surfaces.

data.summary: 16 workers, 3 waves hunting a DE/FR agent swarm. Verdict: NOT FOUND. Evidence against: ~70+ clean urlquery pivots; French time blasts complete (zerobin, data.gouv.fr, frama.link, mistral, qwant, geoportail — zero bursts); 1,031 base64 blobs decoded + 173,768 hex strings + 5,948 tag values — zero DE/FR agent content; CT clean (21 queries, ~37k certs); TLD sweep clean across .de/.fr/.at/.ch/.be/.lu; ~40 Shodan queries across Hetzner/OVH/Scaleway — no DE/FR-hosted swarm; archives clean (Wayback, Arquivo.pt 15-marker battery all 0 with calibration control); GitHub benign. Statistician: at DE/FR ~5-8% world AI share and ~7-8 observed operations globally, lambda 0.4-0.6, P(observing 0) = 0.55-0.67 — zero is the modal outcome; observed swarms come from a rare lab-concentrated process (frontier eval escapes + state-scale collection fleets, ~2 entities worldwide) in which DE/FR field zero entities. Ruled out: DE/FR-locale Amap-analog fleet. NOT ruled out: DE/FR-operated English-task swarm on server-side APIs or encrypted dead-drops (urlquery-invisible by design). Surviving lead (unresolved): usemod.org WikiPatches/ClipBoard — 6,848 edits May 23-31 2026 from five OVH hosts, blank summaries, revisions purged; agent-shaped, unattributed.
data.title: EUROSWARM assessment: no German or French agent swarm found — P(observing zero) 0.55-0.67, zero is the modal outcome

data.summary: 358 unique skill identities enumerated (216 awesome-lists/GitHub + 142 marketplaces); 177 repos/packages fetched; 3,853 skill units scanned; 800 units with egress hits. Top-10 riskiest egress destinations: ngrok/cloudflared tunnels (incl. telnyx-mcp 390K/wk installs); r.jina.ai keyless reader (6 skills incl. trendradar 62.7k stars); Discord/Slack webhooks; uploads.github.com (klavis); catbox.moe (byte-identical gitshot copy in coffee-gb); sci-hub.se with verify=False; autonomous email send (Atomic-Mail); Bitwarden vault via MCP; LocalCan localhost tunnels; Roamzy (agent buys eSIMs with crypto). Corpus-toolkit matches: r.jina.ai CONFIRMED (6 skills); Discord/Slack dead-drop grammar CONFIRMED; gitshot-style uploads CONFIRMED (byte-identical propagation); ngrok-automation CONFIRMED and now generic; verify=False CONFIRMED (4). Clean negatives: webhook.site ZERO across all 3,853 units; httpbun ZERO; epoch nonces / zz labels / A000-ZZEND ZERO — no agent-grammar markers anywhere in the skill supply chain; go-import canaries ZERO. Notable new primitives: tunnel-receiver construction taught to agents (pinme docs instruct building webhook receiver + exposing localhost); wigolo blocklists r.jina.ai (first observed counter-pattern); meta-gateways (pipeworx, SparkForge, Gapup — hundreds of tools behind one operator, remote-only, unscannable). Meta-finding: most-installed MCP servers are remote-only with no public source — the most-installed surface is the least auditable. Evidence grades: confirmed (bytes) / pattern-match / capability; a high score is NOT an accusation.
data.title: Skill-egress top-500 (2026-10-05): corpus toolkit confirmed in skill supply chain; agent-grammar markers cleanly negatived

data.summary: Vocabulary table across swarms. uqscan= : 1,220 urlquery hits, ALL amap.com + fleet's own httpbin.org programs — EXCLUSIVE, zero non-Amap. uqtag= (ltzh beacon exfil): fleet + noise only. sub_poi_navi: perfect fingerprint — 21 httpbin.org + 2 amap.com + 1 httpbun.com, all fleet, zero web hits outside. zzbullk/prepnonce (OpenAI Jun 2026): GONE — zero in current urlquery index. claude2026 labels: false-flag quirk is Tencent-fleet-specific, no cross-swarm travel. ltzh- prefix: unattributed and isolated (207 hits, 99% noise, 6 signal). Bounds: (1) the uq* grammar has not spread — if a shared launcher/toolkit existed across Chinese labs, its tag grammar would leak across fleets; it hasn't. (2) The OpenAI June grammar is dead on this surface. (3) Commodity infra (jina, webhook.site, httpbun, LiveCodes, translate.goog) is the only shared layer — public utilities, not toolkit fingerprints; shared infra != shared operator. (4) zz=oai is a PROVIDER marker, not an eval marker (librarian C10).
data.title: Cross-swarm vocabulary hunt (2026-10-05): every fleet's vocabulary is fleet-exclusive — the uq* grammar has not spread

data.summary: In-depth report on the Dream Taiwan swarm (offensive Jul 1-4 2026, launched on CPC founding anniversary Jul 1). Covers: timeline; framework composition; sub-agent structure and wave numbering; the Bayesian decision engine (two layers); learning cycles and self-correction; attack chain per Dream's blog; guardrail bypass; linguistic forensics (Simplified Chinese internal tongue, Traditional Chinese target-analysis tongue, English jailbreak framing 'authorized penetration test'); grammar extracted for hunting; evidence inventory (what Dream recovered, what was independently verified, what remains unconfirmed); related incidents in the same tooling family (do not conflate); publication status; all evidence and seen URLs. Dream agents used Markdown files as persistent memory (1,395-file archive) — cross-cultural agent tradecraft, not a regional quirk.
data.title: Dream Security Taiwan swarm in-depth report (Jul 2026): framework composition, Bayesian decision engine, linguistic forensics
